claim_text: Transport from C_U to A gives w_0=beta*(1-beta*o_0)/m, w_1=beta*(1-beta*o_1)/m, d_0=beta^2*o_0 and d_1=beta^2*o_1, with beta applied exactly once.
selection_status: no source member selected; payoff-invariant coordinates retained
assumptions_used: C_U native payoffs; A is one date before C; beta in (0,1)

claim_text: Under unanimity each weak voter has exactly one pivotal profile, all other weak voters yes, and votes yes iff its own x_j is at least its own once-discounted literal continuation payoff; equality gives yes.
domain: all feasible proposals and all weak identities
selection_status: unique vote from as-if-pivotal plus T^Y
assumptions_used: sealed simultaneous weak ballot; H automatic yes; own-payoff comparison only

claim_text: Every proposal posterior must lie in E_U={0} union (nu_star,1]; otherwise a feasible rejected history requires the none cell of C_U and the assessment is inadmissible.
selection_status: no payoff sentinel and no silent domain restriction
assumptions_used: kappa_U total on rejected histories; no signaling from weak votes

claim_text: The maximum accepted H payoffs are p_0=1-beta+beta^2*o_0 and p_1=1-beta+beta^2*o_1, while rejection pays d_0 or d_1 as specified by the selected continuation cell.
assumptions_used: feasibility; pivotal vote floors; full Y considered

claim_text: Every interior PBE equalizes the two type payoffs, U_0=U_1=u, and u lies in [max{p_0,d_1},p_1].
selection_status: complete payoff restriction without choosing u
assumptions_used: both types have positive prior; one-shot imitation at prescribed proposal beliefs

claim_text: No PBE exists: equalization requires u>=d_1>p_0, which eliminates posterior-zero support and contradicts Bayes plausibility at nu<=nu_star.
selection_status: cell is none; no payoff imputed
assumptions_used: local Bayes; continuation none cell forbidden; pure weak votes

claim_text: PBE exists and every member has payoff vector (p_0,p_0); the symbolic family generator is necessary and sufficient and includes separating, semi-pooling, mixing and delay at Delta=0.
selection_status: complete family retained; no member selected
assumptions_used: local Bayes; Borel proposal measures; literal Borel kappa_U

claim_text: The complete H payoff image is the closed interval u in [max{p_0,d_1},p_1], and every point is attained by an atomic pooling witness while the family preserves all other admissible binders.
selection_status: interval and full binder family retained; no point selected
assumptions_used: local Bayes; Borel proposal measures; literal Borel kappa_U

claim_text: At nu=0 the low type uniquely proposes q_0; the zero-prior high type's complete best-response family is determined by the sign of Delta and the type-payoff vector is (p_0,max{p_0,d_1}).
assumptions_used: prior-support preservation; sequential rationality required for both types

claim_text: At nu=1 support preservation fixes posterior one everywhere and both types have the unique proposal best response q_1, with payoff vector (p_1,p_1).
selection_status: unique proposal and payoff; literal continuation multiplicity preserved

claim_text: The six-condition interior member generator is necessary and sufficient, gives complete sequential strategies and beliefs, and rules out profitable deviations by either H type over all feasible Y.
assumptions_used: global cap on high-belief accepted proposals; exact support best-response sets

claim_text: On-path rejection and endogenous delay occur only in binders with u=d_1>=p_0 and positive proposal mass on the high-cell rejection set; equal payoffs do not identify a unique outcome distribution.
selection_status: outcome multiplicity remains inside the same atomic binder
assumptions_used: pure weak votes; literal continuation outcomes; no outcome-envelope recombination

claim_text: Each weak identity's payoff and the complete outcome law are computed from its own proposal coordinate or its own once-discounted literal continuation coordinate, using the same atomic binder as H strategies, beliefs and kappa_U.
assumptions_used: identity-specific proposal payoffs; literal source member; same binder

claim_text: The exact ex ante H image is {p_0} at nu=0; empty for low positive priors with Delta<0; {p_0} for low positive priors with Delta>=0; [max{p_0,d_1},p_1] for nu_star<nu<1; and {p_1} at nu=1.
selection_status: exact image set reported before envelopes
assumptions_used: type payoffs computed before applying prior weights

claim_text: The five cells are mutually exclusive and exhaustive; every exists cell has a necessary-and-sufficient family record and the none cell has a proof certificate without a payoff sentinel.
assumptions_used: 0<nu_star<1; sign partition of Delta; endpoint support treated separately
